description: This file contains a set of shell test scripts for verifying the behavior of 'git update-index --refresh' related to handling racy timestamps. It includes setup routines, test cases with assertions, and configuration commands.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets test files 'file' and 'other' with current timestamps.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Sets the mtime of '.git/index' and runs 'git update-index' with a specific flag, asserting that the index's mtime changed.
